silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Each task must choose exactly one method, with no splitting or mixing of methods for a task.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about method exclusivity or cardinality per task; it assumed the one-method-per-task structure in the READY_TO_MODEL summary.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent stopped at READY_TO_MODEL while the P0 hidden slot H1 (exactly one method per task) remained unresolved and was silently assumed.

summary: The agent clarified the objective and many modeling details, but failed to ask about the P0 method-exclusivity rule and silently assumed exactly one method per task, making the stop premature.

restoration_summary.rule: Core exact uses P0/P1 only; all-slot exact uses P0/P1/P2. P2-only cases are not applicable to core exact.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
